requirement_vague: Creating a todo without a title returns a validation error

omissions.description: POST /todos does not return the specified 400 Bad Request with a validation error indicating 'The Title field is required.' when title is missing or empty.
omissions.reasoning: The create_todo route accepts TodoCreate where title is declared as a required str, so a missing title will be rejected by FastAPI/Pydantic before entering the handler. However, FastAPI's default request validation response is 422 Unprocessable Entity, not 400 Bad Request, and its error body format/message will not be 'The Title field is required.' There is also no custom validation enforcing non-empty title with that exact message.

omissions.description: POST /todos does not validate an empty title field as required.
omissions.reasoning: TodoCreate defines title: str but does not add any constraint such as min_length=1 or custom validator. An empty string satisfies the type check, so create_todo will accept and persist a todo with an empty title instead of returning a validation error.
